items.headline: Atlas Lithium Announce ~71% Of Neves Project Capex Is Supported By Executed Contracts And Firm Agreements With Selected Execution Partners
items.snippet: On its second-quarter earnings call held August 6, 2026, Albemarle Corporation reported that global lithium consumption grew 45% year-over-year through May 2026, while new supply additions lagged.

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike, easing a supply-disruption risk for lithium from the Atacama Desert operations.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in first half of 2026 after subsidy withdrawals, yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May, above Albemarle's 15%-to-40% forecast range. Stationary storage is driving the gap.

items.headline: Albemarle's Lithium Math Turns Brutal
items.snippet: JPMorgan now expects lithium prices to remain in the low-$20-per-kilogram range, down from mid-$20s. Albemarle faces delays at Greenbushes CGP3 plant following a June fire; shares down 5.16% at $134.21.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166, citing lithium prices coming off this cycle's peak in Q2.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating, citing reduced lithium EBITDA multiple.
